label_contract.independence_requirement: Y_ind is produced by a checker that is not used to optimize the policy or construct the auxiliary score.
label_contract.blinding: The checker receives completion text and task metadata but not arm, auxiliary score, terminal reward, seed, or checkpoint selection status.
label_contract.adjudication: Disagreements between the registered parser and independent checker are adjudicated on a preregistered stratified sample by a blinded third procedure; raw and adjudicated labels are both retained.
label_contract.one_class_rule: If Y_ind has fewer than two classes in any required terminal-reward stratum on the untouched test split, that stratum is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE and cannot pass. It is never imputed or silently pooled away.

data_contract.split_method: hash-partition prompt_id into development and untouched test before fitting any calibration model

primary_analysis.estimand: For each auxiliary arm, prompt-clustered untouched-test mean log-loss reduction in nats per completion from adding the cross-fitted auxiliary score to the registered control model.
control_model_features: one-hot task with levels frozen before labels are opened
one-hot model_scale with levels frozen before labels are opened

estimator_specification.hyperparameter_selection: none; every estimator setting is fixed by this packet
estimator_specification.continuous_preprocessing: Within each development training fold, fit mean and population-standard-deviation on that fold only; apply those values to its validation fold and untouched test. A zero-variance feature is set to zero and recorded.
estimator_specification.categorical_preprocessing: Use the frozen level lists, treatment coding, and an explicit UNKNOWN level; levels are fit without Y_ind.
estimator_specification.cross_fit_predictions: Fit five models, each excluding one prompt fold. Development out-of-fold predictions come from the excluded-fold model. Untouched-test probability is the arithmetic mean of the five fold-model probabilities.
estimator_specification.loss: binary log loss in natural-log units per completion

primary_analysis.candidate_model_addition: one fold-standardized preregistered auxiliary score and its interaction with terminal_reward_stratum
primary_analysis.placebo: Within each development training fold and each task by model_scale by terminal_reward_stratum cell, permute the auxiliary score with seed 20260729, preserving its observed marginal distribution. Apply the same fitted candidate pipeline to this placebo feature.
confirmatory_contrasts: spectral candidate versus its within-cell permutation placebo
entropic candidate versus its within-cell permutation placebo

bootstrap.multiplicity_rule: Bonferroni across all four confirmatory contrasts

primary_analysis.arm_pass_rule: Both-class support must hold in every required stratum. For both the arm-versus-control and arm-versus-placebo contrasts, the point estimate must be at least 0.01 nats per completion and the 98.75% prompt-cluster bootstrap lower confidence bound must exceed 0.0.
secondary_metrics: stratum-specific AUC only when Y_ind has both classes

power_gate.variance_source: blinded development-only pilot with prompt-cluster resampling
power_gate.required_output: power_receipt.json containing the estimated intracluster correlation, effective prompt count, required prompt count, and achieved power
power_gate.decision_rule: If achieved power is below 0.8 at the frozen feasible sample budget, S2 is NOT_FEASIBLE and training remains blocked.

training_amendment_boundary.matched_input_rule: Use byte-identical prompt schedules, initial checkpoint hashes, task mixtures, and charged-token budgets across arms. Fresh on-policy arms must retain arm-specific completion-manifest hashes; realized completions are not required or expected to be byte-identical after policies diverge.
